fixer.title: agentHost: open, navigate, and search long chats on demand

introducer.title: agentHost: use windowed delivery for state channels

cases.mechanism: Relay chat subscriptions requested an unbounded completed-turn snapshot. The host sent the full retained transcript through relay JSON/chunk encoding, whose 32-MiB reassembly ceiling rejects sufficiently long chats after allocating/serializing the payload.
cases.symptom: Opening a chat with more than 32 MiB of retained response JSON cannot deliver its opening snapshot over the relay, while smaller long chats incur full-history transfer and restoration latency.
cases.fixedBehavior: The client now requests a ten-turn relay view. ChatHistoryView constructs a normally 4-MiB tail with a hard transport ceiling before the final response is serialized; older turns are transferred only through explicit reads/pages.
cases.evidence: The deleted base request option at agentHostProtocolClient.ts:2158 supplied only bypassReconnectGate, with no history view. Blame identifies the commit carrying that request. Added line 2261 supplies view.turns=10 for WebPubSub chat subscriptions. ProtocolServerHandler._pagedChatBaseline replaces completed turns with the bounded ChatHistoryView.baseline result; chunking.ts:113–117 proves the existing 32-MiB rejection. Existing provider restoration remains unchanged.
